thesis: The speakers argue that English is becoming the new programming language, marking the biggest leap forward in programming history since the introduction of compilers. They contend that while AI agents can now write code and handle technical stacks, the primary barrier to building software is no longer accidental complexity like environment setup, but rather the syntax of code itself, which is an unnatural language for humans.
